title: OPS-CLOUD-FAILOVER-PAPER-SCAFFOLD-01 standby identity/status payload
description: SCAFFOLD ONLY. This schema does not grant execution authority, does not implement cloud failover, and does not describe a runtime-integrated status report -- it is the future connection contract a separate OPS-CLOUD-FAILOVER-PAPER-01 program would implement against. `standby_readiness: ready_for_future_takeover_evaluation` never means permission to trade.

deployment_mode.description: This scaffold supports PAPER only. Any other value is UNSUPPORTED_LIVE_MODE.

live_capability.description: Must always be false/disabled in this scaffold. There is no transition to true anywhere in this contract.

config_identity.description: Hash of this node's local layered config, for cross-node identity comparison.

protocol_schema_identity.description: Identifies which version of THIS schema the payload was produced against.

database_recovery_snapshot_identity.description: Identity of the most recent recovery-backup DB snapshot this node knows about (see OPS-OFFSITE-BACKUP-01 manifest.json).

future_lease_backend.description: Placeholder identifier for a FUTURE durable renewable-leadership lease backend. Empty string = not configured. This scaffold never acquires a lease.

future_fencing_generation.description: Placeholder generation/fencing token field for a FUTURE fencing implementation. This scaffold never generates one.

standby_readiness.description: ready_for_future_takeover_evaluation means only that this scaffold's own checks passed -- it is NOT permission to trade, arm, or promote a standby, and this contract defines no transition to execution.
